data.title: Dream, build, destroy, repeat
data.description: The MIT Combat Robotics Club (CRC) builds high-energy fighting machines to compete in House Battles and larger competitions. Fans of the hit show BattleBots may remember some of CRC’s past robots, including Uppercut, SawBlaze, the Dentist, and Overhaul.
